test_snapshot_download_main_revision: test snapshot_download to retrieve files from the main branch revision of a repository
test_snapshot_download_specific_revision: test snapshot_download with a specific commit hash revision to download files from that commit
test_snapshot_download_private_repo: test snapshot_download fails without token on private repo and succeeds with cached or explicit token
test_snapshot_download_local_files_only: test snapshot_download with local_files_only flag to load cached or local copies without network access
test_snapshot_download_offline_mode: test snapshot_download returns cached or local folder when network connection errors occur in offline mode
